disclaimer: Simplified estimate: 10% salary tax after the annualized non-taxable amount (RSD 300,000 for 2024). An additional 10% applies on income above roughly 3x the average annual salary — not included here.

regimes.label: Salary Tax (10%)
regimes.notes: Serbia applies 10% on salary above the non-taxable amount (RSD 25,000/month in 2024, annualized to 300,000). High-income additional rate (10% above threshold) is excluded.
